# docNN: <Completed work unit>

- Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
- Scope: <coherent outcome and exclusions>
- State: <implementation, review, commit, publication, merge and deployment, each stated separately>
- Outcome: <one sentence on what a person can now do or what is now true>

## What changed

<What changed and why. Link current guides, contracts and decisions instead of
copying their instructions. Link earlier records only when they supply context.>

## What was checked

<For each check, record the command or inspection, observed result, date and
environment. Identify prior evidence explicitly. For passive docs, structural
readback and local-link checks may be sufficient; explain why runtime checks were
not applicable. Record failed, blocked, unavailable or skipped checks.>

## Not proven

<Optional. What the checks in this record cannot establish: fixture-only evidence,
live observations that are not repeatable, unobserved deployments. Omit the section
when the record already covers it under Remaining work.>

## Remaining work

<Unfinished scope, missing evidence and next action. Link the handoff for the
current checkpoint; this section records what was known on the date above.>

## References

<Optional when the sections above already link every owning document.>

## Optional sections

Use these headings only when they carry information the required ones do not:

- `## Decisions` — choices made inside this work unit that are too local for an ADR.
- `## Accepted differences` — deliberate divergence from an approved reference.
- `## Correction, <date>` — a dated correction of this record, added instead of
  rewriting the original outcome.

Records doc01 to doc21 use the earlier section names (Objective, Changes and
rationale, Verification, Delivery state). Those records are dated evidence and keep
their original structure; do not rewrite them to match this template. Every record
from doc22 onward uses the sections above.
